name: scottietd
caption:
TRIPLE-DOUBLES 🎮🏀 Kyle Lowry owns our triple-double record. Scottie Barnes is coming for it.

• Lowry: 16 regular-season triple-doubles for us, over 9 seasons
• Scottie: 9 in his first 5 seasons
• 2023-24: 4 in one season, a franchise record
• Dec 28, 2025 vs Golden State: 23 PTS, 25 REB, 10 AST, our first 20-20 triple-double
• In his 8 games this season: none yet, closest was 22-15-8 vs the Clippers

Does Scottie break Lowry's record? 👇

beats.name: LOWRY
beats.vo: Kyle Lowry owns our triple-double record: sixteen, over nine seasons. Scottie Barnes already has nine, in just five.

beats.name: SCOTTIE

beats.head: CATCH LOWRY?
beats.vo: Seven to tie, eight to break it. Does Scottie get there? Comment below.

facts.claim: Kyle Lowry holds the Toronto Raptors franchise record for triple-doubles: 16
ESPN game logs: Lowry had 16 regular-season triple-doubles with Toronto across 9 seasons (2012-13 to 2020-21); 7 to tie, 8 to break
ESPN game logs: Scottie Barnes had 9 regular-season triple-doubles in his first 5 seasons (2021-22 to 2025-26: 0, 1, 4, 1, 3) and none in his first 8 games of 2026-27
Feb 26, 2024: Barnes recorded his fourth (4) triple-double of the 2023-24 season, setting a franchise record for most triple-doubles in a season (1 season)
Dec 28, 2025 vs Golden State: Barnes had 23 points, 25 rebounds and 10 assists, the first 20-20 triple-double in Raptors history
